title: DocsAlot — A support answer with a source
concept: Launch film for the support bot. One customer asks in Slack, gets a cited answer, and the citation cuts to the exact source sentence. A second question shows a gap in the docs.
footnotes: REAL: the question is DocsAlot's own documented example ("@docsalot How do I configure authentication?"); the answer and the highlighted sentence come from their real Authentication page (docs.docsalot.dev/document-apis/authentication); logo from docsalot.dev.
PLACEHOLDER: the Slack thread is a neutral rebuild (no Slack branding) until the team records the bot in a test workspace. Shot 5 (docs gap flag) is shown only if DocsAlot can supply that capture.
The end card mentions Discord, which the docs list as a second bot.
